title: Italy's data protection authority fines IQVIA 7 million euros over GDPR violation
content_md:
Italy's data protection authority has fined IQVIA 7 million euros over a GDPR violation. IQVIA operates in the healthcare data sector.

via Mastodon https://malware.news/t/the-italian-italy-s-data-protection-authority-fines-iqvia-7-million-over-data-protection-breach/126114
